name: whatsapp_inbound_messages
description: WhatsApp messages from senders that matched exactly one active Person through an owner-linked number when the signature-verified webhook arrived. Unknown, unlinked or unauthorized senders are never recorded. Each row is processed once, in order per Person, after the sender is authorized again.
lifecycle: Inserted before the webhook is acknowledged and deduplicated by the Meta message id; claimed under a lease, retried a bounded number of times, then completed, ignored (revoked, disabled channel, limits, expired window) or failed. The message text is cleared when processing ends, because the question is kept in the agent conversation. Rows older than 30 days are pruned with their replies (provisional until PH-09).

columns.Meaning: Inbound work identifier; also the agent turn request id, so a repeated attempt replays the same turn.
Meta message id (wamid); the deduplication key for repeated webhook deliveries.
Person the sender matched when the message arrived; processing refuses the message if the sender no longer matches this Person.
Version of the Person's WhatsApp link when the message arrived; a changed or removed link refuses the message.
Sender number exactly as Meta reported it (digits), used only to answer the same sender.
columns.Null meaning: Meta reported only the WhatsApp user identifier.

columns.Meaning: WhatsApp business-scoped user identifier Meta reported.
columns.Null meaning: Not reported by Meta for this message.

columns.Meaning: text, or unsupported for media and other message types this version does not process.
Text of the message while it awaits processing.
columns.Null meaning: Not text, or processing ended and the text was cleared.

columns.Meaning: When the person sent the message, according to Meta; orders processing per Person and bounds the customer service window.
When the webhook delivered the message.
pending, processing, completed, ignored or failed.
Allowlisted code of how processing ended, for example answered, command, revoked, channel_disabled, rate_limited or expired.
Earliest time the message may be claimed (backoff after a busy conversation or a failed attempt).
Expiry of the current processing claim; an expired claim is reclaimed.
Agent conversation that received the message as a turn.
columns.Null meaning: No turn was submitted (command, refusal or still pending).

columns.Meaning: Agent turn created for the message.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((sender_phone IS NOT NULL) OR (sender_user_id IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: Every message has a sender identifier.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'ignored'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying])::text[])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_inbound_messages_message_key ON public.whatsapp_inbound_messages USING btree (message_id)
constraints.Purpose: One row per Meta message: repeated webhook deliveries are ignored.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_inbound_messages_person_idx ON public.whatsapp_inbound_messages USING btree (person_id, sent_at, received_at)
CREATE INDEX whatsapp_inbound_messages_received_idx ON public.whatsapp_inbound_messages USING btree (received_at)
CREATE INDEX whatsapp_inbound_messages_work_idx ON public.whatsapp_inbound_messages USING btree (state, not_before)
